items.quote: For I was commanded by the word of the Lord: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.’
items.contrast: The Lord’s prohibition versus dissatisfaction with the king’s offer.
items.reason: The word “For” directly gives the reason for his refusal: the Lord had commanded him not to eat or drink there. The offer of half the king’s possessions is a hypothetical concession, not the cause of the refusal.
